source: War Journalist retained standalone UI, input, memory and capture services; camera runtime is independently owned
native_encoding: hex; decoded only by package builder

core.lua.change: Opt-in fine_step normalization and commit_on_blur metadata validation; original controls retain existing precision.

PhotoCapture_f37e408d89cd.dll.change: Color-aware HDR10 PQ/BT2020 to SDR sRGB PNG conversion selected by verified live back-buffer HDR state; hash filename preserves loaded old DLL.

PhotoCapture_455c13a828a8.dll.change: Explicit encoding 2 reproduces the native game SDR final-compositor display transfer for HDR10 captures, removing additional Reinhard dimming; fixed native nits normalization ignores white_nits. Legacy encoding 1 and generic SDR encoding 0 preserved; native frame-varying chroma dither omitted for deterministic PNG.

PhotoCapture_7da458d8a23d.dll.change: Keeps encoding 2 native HDR-to-SDR display transfer and adds encoding 3 exclusively for verified SDR engine BGRA payload mislabeled exact DXGI RGBA8 28. Generic encoding 0 and legacy encoding 1 unchanged; white_nits ignored for fixed native profiles.

mcm_input_fcf5b050abc2.dll.change: Forward physical Escape RAW and legacy down/up only in camera capture mode 3; menu mode 1 and all other keys retain capture/drain behavior.
mcm_input_fcf5b050abc2.dll.scope: Photo-owned standalone input library only; external MCM source and published DLL unchanged
mcm_input_fcf5b050abc2.dll.tests: Exact shared RAW/legacy keyboard_event_gate offline harness; no attached windows or injected input

mcm_input_f501fa41de0c.dll.change: Bundled Helldivers hardware cursor for menu WM_SETCURSOR; all input/capture/release policies unchanged. One cached cursor remains alive for the pinned helper lifetime.
mcm_input_f501fa41de0c.dll.tests: Exact-source input and cursor offline native harnesses; no attached windows or injected input.

camera_input.lua.change: Expose capture ownership/readiness; report sampling and focus loss without premature release; retain and retry incomplete cleanup; restore Photo-owned native-menu Window state before capturing the next baseline. External input owners remain authoritative.

view.lua.change: Compare retained primitive scalar snapshots without per-frame signature strings; preserve fresh GUI lifetime, font atlas binding and dynamic uniforms.

chat_context_credit.author: Link
chat_context_credit.behavior: Read-only chat widget open byte; ignores game chat messages and sends no input or chat

native_input_change: Retain cursor/input ownership policies; opt-in raw wheel observation for handycam without consuming gameplay input; drain on transition, release and focus loss.
